prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: opaque background plate for a layered portrait parallax wedding invitation.
Input image 1 is the reference poster and edit target.
Create ONLY the warm antique ivory parchment paper background visible in the reference, filling the entire image. Remove EVERY person, castle, cloud, landscape, moon, owl, banner, symbol, line, border, star, letter and word. Reconstruct the hidden paper seamlessly. Preserve its refined cream, beige, very muted sepia palette, subtle mottled paper fibers and softly aged edges. Keep the central upper area light and quiet for live typography. Flat evenly lit paper, not a photographed sheet. Portrait 864:1820 aspect ratio or closest tall portrait. Texture extends edge to edge with no empty margin, no text, no watermark. This is a single reusable texture layer, not a finished invitation.

Use case: background-extraction, identity-preserve. Asset type: isolated portrait foreground layer for a parallax wedding invitation. Input image 1 is the exact source poster. Extract ONLY the woman from the left bottom of that poster into a genuinely transparent PNG. Preserve her exact facial identity, eye shape, expression, straight black hair and bangs, pose, light skin, white shirt, burgundy striped tie, black wizard school robe with burgundy lining and embroidered gold lion crest. Keep the reference's warm sepia photographic grading and frontal lighting. Reconstruct only the outer hair and robe silhouette that was cropped by the poster edges, staying faithful to her appearance. Single woman facing camera, framed from top of head to lower torso/waist, complete head and hair silhouette, head near upper center, shoulders and robe visible. Portrait aspect ratio. Leave modest transparent padding around head and sides; bottom robe may meet the bottom edge. Remove all text, stars, ornaments, gold lines, castle, background, man, and the phrase on the robe. Do not invent a different person. Fine clean hair alpha edges, no colored fringe, no shadow behind subject, no solid background, no watermark. Output ONE isolated woman.

Use case: background-extraction, identity-preserve. Asset type: isolated portrait foreground layer for a parallax wedding invitation. Input image 1 is the exact source poster. Extract ONLY the man from the right bottom of that poster into a genuinely transparent PNG. Preserve his exact facial identity, eye shape, subtle smile, distinctive facial details, short side-parted black hair, pose, skin tone, white shirt, burgundy striped tie and black wizard school robe with burgundy lining. Keep the reference's warm sepia photographic grading and frontal lighting. Reconstruct only outer head and robe areas cropped by poster edge, staying faithful to his appearance. Single man facing camera, framed from top of head to lower torso/waist, complete head silhouette, head near upper center, shoulders and robe visible. Portrait aspect ratio. Leave modest transparent padding around head and sides; bottom robe may meet bottom edge. Remove every text, star, ornament, gold line, castle, background and woman. Do not invent a different person. Clean alpha edges, no colored fringe, no shadow behind subject, no solid background, no watermark. Output ONE isolated man.

Use case: precise-object-edit, background-extraction. Asset type: transparent midground castle layer for a parallax wedding invitation. Input image 1 is the exact castle to clean. Preserve this exact castle architecture, perspective, warm muted sepia stone colors, pointed roofs, towers, arches, rocky island base and delicate mist below. Change ONLY the cutout boundary: remove all red, yellow and green contamination/fringing along the edges and small leftover background patches between towers. Replace all background with actual transparency. Keep crisp clean fine roof silhouettes and soft semi-transparent mist along the base. Landscape canvas approximately matching reference 855:458 aspect; whole castle visible with thin transparent padding, no cropped towers. No new structures, no people, no sky, no lake, no solid black background, no checkerboard painted in, no text, no watermark. Output one transparent castle cutout.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone semi-transparent BACK CLOUD layer for a layered parallax wedding invitation. Input image 1 is style and composition reference only. Paint a soft bank of warm sepia gray cumulus clouds like those along the left and right middle edges of the poster. Single portrait canvas, approximate 864:1820 aspect ratio. Clouds enter from both side edges in the middle half of canvas, left bank starts around 25% height, right bank starts around 35%; thin faint wisps below. Keep entire top quarter and most of central vertical column completely transparent for readable live wedding text. Bottom quarter mostly transparent. Muted warm gray, beige, antique ivory, low contrast, hand-tinted photographic fantasy illustration. Clouds only: no paper background, no people, no castle, no lake, no moon, no owl, no symbols, no stars, no text, no watermark. All empty areas must be alpha 0, cloud edges naturally fade with partial alpha, not rectangular. Output genuinely transparent PNG, NOT clouds painted on a black/white/checkerboard rectangle. Extend cloud masses beyond side canvas edges for overscan.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone semi-transparent FRONT MIST overlay for a layered parallax wedding invitation. Input image 1 is color/style reference only. Create a single wide horizontally flowing thin bank of soft ivory and warm pale sepia ground mist that will overlap the bottom of the castle. Landscape 2:1 canvas, fog occupies the lower half, wisps reach up at left and right, center slightly lower and mostly clear so castle arch remains visible. Soft airy delicate feathered edges fading to actual alpha 0, center of mist translucent rather than solid. No rectangular backdrop or baked-in checkerboard. Muted antique wedding illustration, diffuse light, no harsh contrast. Mist only: no paper, ground, mountains, people, castle, lake, moon, objects, stars, letters or watermark. Transparent PNG.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone lower landscape layer for a parallax portrait wedding invitation. Input image 1 is exact style/composition reference. Reconstruct ONLY the lower fantasy landscape from the poster behind the couple: a calm reflective lake centered in the foreground, small rocky shorelines at left and right, delicate dark sepia woodland silhouettes on both banks, and subtle pale distant rocky hills. Leave a broad low unoccupied island ledge at center back where a separate castle cutout will later sit. Absolutely NO castle or buildings in this output. Warm desaturated sepia, antique beige, gray olive, softly misty photographic illustration matching reference, gentle reflections. Landscape canvas roughly 3:2, low horizon around 40% from top; lake extends to bottom and side edges. Upper sky region must be truly transparent with naturally fading mist along horizon and organic tree silhouettes. Full lake and land opaque below horizon so paper does not show through water. No people, no portraits, no words, no banners, no stars, no owl, no moon, no decorative symbols, no watermark. Output single landscape PNG with alpha sky.

Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: isolated owl with wedding letter, transparent parallax decoration. Input image 1 is source and exact visual reference. Isolate the small pale owl flying above the castle, carrying an ivory envelope with a small dark burgundy wax seal. Reconstruct the owl at high detail, preserving the source pose: looking toward viewer, one wing lifted high to upper right, other wing spread to left, body angled forward, envelope hanging beneath. Pale ivory feathers with delicate warm sepia shading and natural feather detail, muted antique photographic fantasy illustration. Full bird, all feather tips, feet and envelope inside canvas with generous actual transparent padding. Single owl, single envelope, no other objects. No sky, no castle, no paper background, no halo or drop shadow, no stars, no letters or watermark. Square canvas, genuinely transparent PNG.

Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: single isolated upper LEFT hanging pennant from reference wedding poster. Input image 1 is exact source/style reference. Reproduce ONLY the tall narrow burgundy velvet heraldic banner in upper left, with antique gold double-line border, pointed V-shaped lower end, gold rampant lion emblem centered, and small ornate gold drop finial hanging under the point. Single banner, straight-on view, fabric top edge continues to top canvas edge as if hung from above, subtle antique texture and warm sepia color grading. Canvas narrow portrait about 1:3; width dominated by the one pennant, transparent padding to left/right and below finial. Keep whole finial visible. No pole, wall, room or backdrop. No text, alphabetic lettering, numbers, watermark, person, castle, snake or stars. Output PNG with actual transparent background, no black/white rectangle and no cast shadow outside banner.

Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: single isolated upper RIGHT hanging pennant from reference wedding poster. Input image 1 is exact source/style reference. Reproduce ONLY the tall narrow burgundy velvet heraldic banner in upper right, with antique gold double-line border, pointed V-shaped lower end, gold coiled serpent emblem centered, and small ornate gold drop finial hanging under the point. Match left lion banner proportions: straight vertical narrow fabric, long sides, angled pointed bottom, subtle aged velvet texture in dark wine burgundy and warm gold. Single banner, straight-on view, top fabric edge continues to top canvas edge as if hung from above. Canvas narrow portrait about 1:3; transparent padding to left/right and below finial. Keep whole finial visible. No pole, wall, room or backdrop. No text, alphabetic lettering, numbers, watermark, person, castle, lion or stars. Output PNG with actual transparent background, no black/white rectangle and no cast shadow outside banner.

Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: isolated small golden winged orb decoration for wedding invitation. Input image 1 is exact source/style reference; the target is the small gold winged ball centered below the bottom quote. Create that object alone: one small intricately engraved antique gold sphere and two delicate feather-shaped metallic wings extending symmetrically up-left and up-right. Graceful warm champagne gold, soft light, detailed engraved leaflike feathers, elegant and subtle. Landscape canvas 2:1 with generous transparent padding around all wing tips. No horizontal rules, no quote, no stars, no typography, no other objects, no background, no halo or drop shadow, no watermark. Entire object fully visible. Genuinely transparent PNG.
